goal: Make search choices submit immediately on desktop only while preserving the staged mobile journey.

intent_model.literal_request: Immediate filtering and navigation applies only on desktop; mobile must keep the previous staged flow.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Search feels obvious and fast on desktop without making mobile skip required context or lose the accepted step-by-step interaction.
likely_rejections: Mobile still navigates after choosing a location
Desktop still requires the final search button
Confirmed dates are missing from the destination

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Immediate navigation is gated at the 821-pixel desktop breakpoint.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Desktop and mobile require separate observable checks.

cognitive_flow.current_decision: Desktop applies it immediately; mobile advances to the next required step.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Desktop reviews updated results; mobile completes dates and party before submission.
deferred_complexity: Advanced filters remain on their existing surfaces

natural_destination: Shared VII SearchBox across vacation, events, spa and hourly search routes.

facts.claim: The current shared chooseLocation callback invokes search unconditionally.

assumptions.claim: The established responsive boundary remains 820 pixels.
assumptions.validation: The same component already uses max-width 820px and min-width 821px for its mobile editor.

in_scope: Immediate desktop search after choosing location, date, spa audience or hourly price
Mobile staged location to dates to guests journey
invariants: Mobile final party confirmation submits the search
The explicit search button remains available
Existing SEO landing URL builders remain authoritative
No search world, filter or stored selection is removed

requirements.statement: Mobile choices preserve the staged flow and do not submit early.
The destination uses the exact newly confirmed values.
The behavior is consistent across all SearchBox modes.

acceptance_checks.action: Choose a destination or confirm a date
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The matching results destination is pushed immediately with the selected value.

acceptance_checks.setup: Viewport 390 pixels with the mobile search sheet open
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No navigation occurs and the date stage opens.

acceptance_checks.setup: Mobile visitor selected a destination and dates
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The final search contains the selected destination, dates and party.

acceptance_checks.setup: Desktop visitor confirms dates that differ from component state
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The target URL contains the newly confirmed dates, never the previous dates.
Mobile-only state and document locks are released and desktop search remains usable.

acceptance_checks.setup: Mobile visitor has not completed the staged flow
acceptance_checks.action: Choose an intermediate location or date
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No premature results navigation occurs and incomplete or stale values are not submitted.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and verification only; no publication.
